implementation.name: Computer Space (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 15 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 12 vhdl) alongside 7 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 1 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 0 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 0 distinct machine_id rows. 1 setname(s) did not resolve (no-setname: 1). Machines unmapped: the core's single MRA carries an empty <setname>, and a scan of every <description> in MAME 0.288's -listxml output finds no machine for Nutting Associates' 1971 Computer Space, so there is no machine_id to reference even by hand. License: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file; the grant lives in the source header at https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-ComputerSpace_MiSTer/blob/master/Arcade-ComputerSpace.sv, which offers the work under the GNU General Public License "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 15 source files (1 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 12 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
